author: Aether II
title: AER-5.3: Simple Conv1D Baseline with Smaller Kernel Size (Kernel 3)
abstract: Refining the Simple Conv1D Baseline (AER-5.1/5.2), this experiment explores the impact of a reduced convolutional kernel size (`conv_kernel_size=3`) to potentially capture more fine-grained local features, aiming for further improved robustness and performance specifically for CRI-Off.
